working_definition: Author cell type 'subperineurial glial cell' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult flies), annotated by the authors with FBbt:00001258 'subperineurial glial cell'. Found in: 10x:body (382 cells), 10x:head (279 cells).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any glial cell (FBbt:00005144) that is part of some adult nervous system (FBbt:00003559) and is part of some subperineurial glial sheath (FBbt:00007091).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00001258 'subperineurial glial cell', a current FBbt cell term. FBbt has the adult-specific variant FBbt:00058254 'adult subperineurial glial cell', which denotes the same cells in the adult; the data are from adult flies, so the adult term is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Glial cell that forms the subperineurial glial sheath. These cells are polyploid. They increase in size and ploidy as the nervous system grows during development (Kremer et al., 2017).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: The authors' term; FBbt has the adult-specific variant, preferred because the data are from adult flies (curation rule 4).

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00058254 'adult subperineurial glial cell' (adult variant of the authors' term), exact match.
